anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before kept none of these four facts, so After has nothing to preserve; all four moved to holds, two of them narrowly. The assess and dispatch facts moved because After now persists work_started true and deletes the saved note before the handler runs on both picks, and because the Claude Code finding is stated as the same AC text verbatim, carrying instead, builds, the base locator, P1 and node --test test/index.test.js. The needs fact moved because After adds the Problem 1 block with three headings, the overrule 1 choice, the no-round-charge statement for both harnesses, and the closure-only scope for later review. Its weak point is that both obstacle menus still offer "deliver - retry the repair, but it stops again until the fixture exists", which reads close to offering an unchanged retry; word that row so it is conditional on the fixture being supplied, or drop it while the prerequisite is missing. The payload-limit fact holds only thinly: After names "the payload-limit sentence" in the pi task without spelling out no-infrastructure, no-dependency and no-new-module, and does not say the Claude Code prompt carries it or that needs is the return for a remedy outside the limit. Have the wording make the dispatch print the limit's three terms inside the shared context block for both harnesses, and state that a remedy outside it returns needs <what> on pi and open - needs <what> on Claude Code.

For assess, Before kept the saved checked note unchanged and never recorded work_started, while After persists work_started true, deletes the note and clears reject before the single REQUEST_CHANGES post, confirms commit_id and renders assess-terminal with only stop and deliver. Payload-limit held in both: Before stated no new dependency, infrastructure or module in its task rules, and After quotes the limit and names the needs <what> and open - needs <what> returns. To keep all four, keep the instruction to save work_started and delete the note before any post or dispatch, keep the payload-limit sentence quoted in both worker tasks, and keep the three-section stuck report tied to the observed missing input rather than an invented failure. One thing to tighten: the retained P1 and course deliver at the stuck exit are only implied by the report and the earlier persistence step, so state them explicitly in the stuck-exit step.
